facts.text: Elizabethtown College provides the Momentum Program, a voluntary, no-cost transition program for incoming first-year students who are first-generation or Pell-eligible.

sources.title: Momentum Program | Elizabethtown College
sources.quote: Momentum is a voluntary, no-cost program. Invitations are extended each spring to incoming first-year students who are first-generation or Pell-eligible. Momentum is open to both residential and commuter students.
